title: fr.camera.stream_ended event
description: A stream (or sd_fetch) ended: stopped (stream_stop), done (`seconds` or `max_frames` reached), net_lost (a send stalled 3 s or the connection dropped), overflow (the card is full or failed mid-stream), error (the sensor failed).

frames.description: frames the stream covered, dropped ones included (the index it reached)

dropped.description: frames the sensor delivered that the stream could not take (the hub path behind)
